 How to Get Ready Now for a Faster Tax Refund in 2027 With Credit Karma Tax
 A little tax prep now can help you avoid refund holdups next year. Here’s how to get ready, plus where Credit Karma Tax comes in.
 By
 PCMag BrandX for Credit Karma 
 November 17, 2026

 If you plan to use your tax refund to pay down credit card debt or save money, preparing now can help you get that money as soon as possible. Credit Karma Tax can help by prefilling your information from a photo or imported forms, and by running thousands of accuracy checks before you hit submit. 
 It offers $0 federal and $15 per state filing,* regardless of the complexity of your return. This is a new offering , separate from the former Credit Karma Tax service offered before Intuit acquired Credit Karma. Here’s how to prepare for the upcoming filing season to get a faster return with Credit Karma Tax . 
 Credit Karma Tax
 Learn More 
 What Can You Do Now to Get Your 2027 Tax Refund Faster?
 For the fastest tax return payments, the IRS recommends e-filing and choosing direct deposit to help you receive your refund sooner. Mistakes are one of the biggest causes for tax return delays. Make sure to avoid these common mistakes that could affect your return:
 Incorrect personal information: Each name and Social Security number on your return needs to match what’s on your Social Security card. 
 Inaccurate banking details: Double-check your bank account and routing numbers, since the wrong information can delay your refund or send it to the wrong account.
 Missing forms: Wait until you have all your tax documents before filing, including bank interest forms. 
 Here’s how Credit Karma Tax can help before, during, and after you file:

 What Documents Do You Need to File Your Taxes in 2027?
 The documents you’ll need to file your 2026 return depend on your income sources and any deductions or credits you plan to claim. Use this checklist to determine which documents apply to you:
 If you worked for an employer: Gather a W-2 from each employer, which is a form that reports your wages and any taxes withheld from your paycheck.
 If you freelanced or earned side income: You may receive Form 1099-NEC, which reports payments for work performed as an independent contractor. Form 1099-K reports payments received through payment cards, apps, or online marketplaces. You must report taxable income even if you didn’t receive a tax form.  
 If you attended college or paid student loan interest: Look for Form 1098-T, which reports tuition-related information from your school. Form 1098-E reports any student loan interest paid. 
 If you earned interest or sold investments: Form 1099-INT reports interest income, like interest from a savings account. Form 1099-B reports the sale of stocks and other securities through a broker. 
 If you sold or exchanged crypto: You may receive Form 1099-DA, which reports digital asset transactions through a broker. Keep your transaction history, including purchase dates, costs, and sale proceeds. 
 Credit Karma Tax can prefill information from a photo of your W-2 or digital forms imported from employers and financial institutions. Having these records organized makes it easier to review the details and fill in any missing information before you submit. 
 How Long Does It Take to Get a Tax Refund, and Which Dates Matter?
 According to the IRS , refunds typically arrive about three weeks after e-filing. If you mail a paper return, expect six weeks or longer from when the IRS receives it. However, errors or additional review can delay your refund. 
 As you prepare to file your 2026 return, keep this timeline in mind:
 Filing season opens: As of November 2026, the IRS hasn’t announced the opening date for the 2027 individual tax filing season. 
 Mid-February: Under the Protecting Americans from Tax Hikes (PATH) Act, the IRS can’t issue refunds on returns claiming the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) or Additional Child Tax Credit (ACTC) before mid-February. 
 April 15, 2027: This is the federal tax filing and payment deadline for most people submitting a 2026 return. 
 How Do You Track Your Federal and State Tax Refund?
 You can track your federal refund through the IRS’s Where’s My Refund? tool or the official IRS app , previously called IRS2Go. Refund status is usually available within 24 hours after the IRS accepts your electronically filed return. 
 Have your Social Security number or individual taxpayer identification number (ITIN), filing status, tax year, and exact federal refund amount available. The tracker shows three stages:
 Return received: The IRS has received your return and is processing it.
 Refund approved: The IRS has approved your refund and provided an expected refund date.
 Refund sent: Your refund has been sent to your financial institution, though your bank may need additional time to make the funds available. 
 To find information about the state refund, visit your state tax agency’s website and look for its refund-status tool. State refunds are processed separately, so your federal refund status won’t tell you when your state payment will arrive.
 How Is Your Refund Calculated, and How Can You Make the Most of It?
 You’ll typically receive a tax refund when you’ve paid more federal income tax than you owe. That includes money withheld from your paychecks and estimated tax payments you made during the year. 
 For example, if you paid $4,000 but your final tax bill is $3,000, you’d usually get $1,000 back. Deductions and credits can also help lower your tax bill and potentially increase your refund.
 Credit Karma’s Refund Agent helps you create a plan for your refund before it arrives. Whether you want to catch up on bills or build your savings, Credit Karma Tax offers tools to help you prepare your return and plan for what comes next. 
 Disclosures: 
 * Per state filing flat-fee subject to change. 
 FAQ 
 How Much Does Credit Karma Tax Cost?
 Credit Karma Tax offers $0 federal and $15 per state filing, regardless of how complex your return is. Optional services like Expert Final Review and the Plus Bundle cost extra, but you don’t have to purchase these to file your return. 
 Can Credit Karma Tax Help Me Get My Refund Faster?
 Credit Karma Tax runs thousands of accuracy checks before you submit, which can help you catch errors that could delay your refund. E-filing and choosing direct deposit can also help you receive your money sooner. Credit Karma Tax also offers faster access to refunds this season. 
 When Can I File My 2026 Taxes?
 As of November 2026, the IRS hasn’t announced when it will begin accepting 2026 individual tax returns. It typically starts in mid to late January, and the federal filing and payment deadline is April 15, 2027 for most taxpayers. 
 How Do I Check the Status of My Tax Refund?
 Use the IRS’s Where’s My Refund? tool or the official IRS app to check the status of your refund. For a state refund, use your state tax agency’s refund tracker. 
 What Is the Credit Karma Tax 100% Accuracy Guarantee?
 The 100% accuracy guarantee covers penalties and interest resulting from a calculation error by Credit Karma Tax.  
 What Can I Do With My Tax Refund?
 You can use your refund to catch up on bills, pay down debt, and save money. Credit Karma’s Refund Assistant can help you explore your options, while the Refund Agent can help you come up with a plan.
